learning_outcomes.text: To know workplaces, where they get in touch with current market developments, to give them the opportunity to acquire new knowledge, to participate actively in teamwork and decision making, to develop their skills, to participate in design and finish projects and to have a first full working experience.
To transfer their knowledge and experience to the companies and the opposite, with the aim of upgrading the studies at the Department and maintaining the high level of knowledge provided.
Strengthens the department's relationships with stakeholders and the local community and creates job opportunities for its graduates.

syllabus_topics: Practical Training of students as part of the Department's Undergraduate Program of Studies
Participation by completing the sixth (6) semester of study
Accumulation of over 120 ECTS at the time of application
Selection of students based on criteria set by the Department's Practical Training Committee
Student selection based on average rating
Student selection based on ECTS credits at the time of the application
teaching_methods: Use of email and social media for information exchange and improved communication

assessment_methods.method: Submission of required forms by the student, the institution, and the academic supervisor

assessment_rules: If the student is judged to have successfully completed the practice, one point with degree excellent (10) is added to their card. The acceptance of this point and degree is approved by the Assembly of the Department.
degree: Computer Science and Engineering (Diploma, 4 years / 240 ECTS, undergraduate programme)
